body_markdown:
SOUTH BOSTON, Va., Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — **IperionX Limited (NASDAQ: IPX, ASX: IPX) (IperionX)** is pleased to invite shareholders and investors to a webinar on ***Tuesday, November 3, 2026 at 10:00 am Australian Eastern Daylight Time / Monday, November 2, 2026 at 18:00 pm U.S. Eastern Standard Time*** , where Founder and CEO, Taso Arima will provide a company update.


Details of the event are as follows:


**** **Event:** IperionX Webinar


**** **Presenter:** Founder and CEO, Taso Arima


**** **Time:** Tue., Nov 3, 2026 at 10:00 am AEDT / Mon., Nov 2, 2026 at 18:00 pm U.S. EST


**** **Where:** Zoom webinar


**** **Registration link:**[https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_0ZcrgMM3SzG2qzhwPZbzlw](https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_0ZcrgMM3SzG2qzhwPZbzlw)


After registering your interest, you will receive a confirmation email with information about joining the webinar.
